# QA Plan: Touchline (standing plan for the whole game)
**Date**: 2026-10-24
**Generated by**: the test-plan template, filled from `package.json` and `tools/`
**Scope**: every system in `design/gdd/systems-index.md`
**Engine**: plain JavaScript on `window.FM`, run in the browser and a web worker; Node runs the same code for checks
**Sprint File**: none (this is the standing plan; per-change plans go beside it)

---

## Test Summary

| Area | Type | Automated check | Manual verification |
|------|------|-----------------|---------------------|
| Text, escaping, names, signing rules, converter | Logic | `npm run test:unit` (65 checks) | None |
| Markup escaping | Logic | `npm run check:escape` (baseline 0) | None |
| Saves open and play on | Integration | `npm run test:saves` | Open a real save after a change to state |
| Built game loads and plays three days | Integration | `npm run build` then `npm run test:smoke` (47 checks) | None |
| Seasons run end to end | Integration | `npm test` (2 seasons), `npm run test:suite`, `npm run test:long` (20 seasons) | None |
| Balance (goals, titles, growth, injuries, retirement) | Config/Data | `npm run calibrate`, `npm run test:wonderkids` | Read the report for out-of-range lines |
| Competition rules and formats | Logic | `npm run test:competitions`, `test:cups`, `test:schedule`, `test:asia`, `test:tactics` | Spot-check a league's table and fixtures |
| World editor and databases | Integration | `npm run test:editor`, `test:worlddef`, `test:dbimport`, `test:import` | Open the editor, edit, apply to a career |
| Real-data converters | Config/Data | `npm run test:realstats` | None |
| Screens | UI | Lint, format and typecheck only | Screenshot each screen touched (phone width and desktop) |
| Match view | Visual/Feel | None | Play a match; check dots, prompts, speed |
| Performance on phones | Visual/Feel | `npm run test:longrun` (time per day) | Play on a mid-range phone |

**Totals**: this plan lists 14 areas: 5 logic, 4 integration, 3 config/data, 1 UI, 2 visual/feel (some appear twice above).

---

## Automated Tests Required

### The deploy gate (before every push)
`npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:saves && npm run check:escape && npm run build && npm run test:smoke`

A failing gate silently stops the site deploying. After pushing, check `gh run list --limit 1`.

### Slow checks (one at a time; they take minutes on this machine)
- `npm run test:editor`
- `npm run test:competitions`
- `npm run test:long`

**What to test, by change**:
- Rules or registration: `test:unit`, `test:competitions`.
- Anything in the season loop, transfers or contracts: `npm test`, `test:saves`.
- Ratings, growth or the engine: `calibrate`, `test:wonderkids`.
- Editor, world definition or import: `test:editor`, `test:worlddef`, `test:dbimport`.
- A new field on players, clubs or the state: `test:saves` and a manual open of an older save.

**Edge cases to cover**:
- A career with the editor switched off (no Edit buttons, no expansion).
- An unemployed manager: every screen reachable without a club must work (the allowed-action list in `js/ui-core.js`).
- A closed league (no promotion or relegation): contracts offer no relegation wage cut.
- The American league's salary budget with all three Designated Player places used.
- A save made before a change: it must open and play on.

## Manual QA Checklist

### New or changed screens — UI
**Verification method**: screenshot at phone width, then desktop
**Who must sign off**: the project owner
**Evidence to capture**: one screenshot per screen touched

Checklist:
- [ ] Tap targets are at least 44 px and text is readable
- [ ] No emoji except nation flags
- [ ] Every user-entered or generated name goes through `esc()`; counts use `U.plural`
- [ ] Works when unemployed, and with the editor off, where reachable
- [ ] Light and dark themes both read well

### Sim forward and Sim without stopping — Integration
**Verification method**: manual step-through
- [ ] Sim stops for decisions with the option off
- [ ] With the option on, staff answer offers, press questions and meetings, and the toast says what they did
- [ ] A sacking or a job offer still stops it

### Full world editor on a career — Integration
**Verification method**: manual step-through
- [ ] Rename a league and a club, apply, and both show in the game
- [ ] Add a club: refused with a reason
- [ ] League format change: applied at the new season

---

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before any hand-off:

1. The game opens to the title screen without an error in the console
2. A new career can be started and three days played (`npm run test:smoke` does this on `dist`)
3. A save is written and read back with the same players and day
4. An older save opens and plays on (`npm run test:saves`)
5. The offline cache lists every file (`sw.js` `CACHE` bumped when files change)
6. Time per simulated day stays near the figures in `docs/ROADMAP.md` (Performance at scale)

---

## Playtest Requirements

| Story | Playtest Goal | Min Sessions | Target Player Type |
|-------|--------------|--------------|-------------------|
| A first season | Is the flow from title to first match clear in a few minutes? | 3 | New to the game, knows football |
| A long save (10+ seasons) | Does it stay fast and stable, and does history read well? | 1 | Football Manager veteran |
| Editor use in a career | Can a player fix a name or rating without breaking the world? | 2 | Anyone who edits |

Playtest notes go in `docs/ROADMAP.md` as "Playtest feedback, round N".

## Definition of Done for This Plan

- [ ] The deploy gate passes
- [ ] Slow checks relevant to the change have passed, one at a time
- [ ] Manual checklist items for any screen touched are ticked, with screenshots
- [ ] Docs travel with the code: ROADMAP bullet, FEATURES, `node tools/docsync.mjs --mark`
- [ ] The deploy run on GitHub succeeded (`gh run list --limit 1`)
